name: poiesis-design
description: Design toolkit for Claude Code, in two plugins: poiesis-ui (how an interface looks) and poiesis-ux (how an app behaves).

plugins.name: poiesis-ui
plugins.description: How your interface looks: text sizes, hierarchy, spacing and color, all derived from a few values you choose. Rules, an auditor that checks your code, and a gate that holds back publishing until the check passes.

plugins.name: poiesis-ux
plugins.description: How your app behaves for the people using it: rules for feedback, errors, control, keyboard use and wording, and a tester that does your app's main tasks the way a person would and reports what gets in their way.
